definition: Apache Beam defines batch and streaming data pipelines through a unified model that runs on supported processing back ends.
entry_text: Apache Beam defines batch and streaming data pipelines through a unified model that runs on supported processing back ends.
example: An engineer uses the same transformation logic for historical records and newly arriving events.
label: Apache Beam

sources.note: Beam documents one data-parallel programming model for bounded and unbounded collections and describes runners executing pipelines on their chosen processing engines. Runner capabilities can differ.
